english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when the context makes clear that the hearing was accidental or unintended.

examples.english: I overhear them saying they are not coming home tonight.
examples.traditional: 我喺門口等緊嗰陣，聽到佢哋講今晚唔返屋企。
